telemetryFinding.evidence: telemetry.uuid (16 B) written by pwsh into both private home directories (executor and caller outputs); created only when PowerShell telemetry is enabled
telemetryFinding.consequence: caller, supervisor and observer ran with PowerShell telemetry on; each start may have attempted an outbound send; conflicts with stated no-network isolation; unrelated to the G0 failure
telemetryFinding.cause: caller, executor and frozen supervisor child environments set DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT but not POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT; clearing drops any user-level setting
telemetryFinding.smallestCorrection: add POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT='1' to the caller and executor environment tables; frozen supervisor fixture children still lack it unless revised; Root records that deviation or requests a supervisor revision
telemetryFinding.artifactHandling: telemetry.uuid files are pseudonymous device identifiers; keep local, do not publish
